name: Kettlebell Double Snatch
steps: Stand with a wider-than-shoulder stance behind two kettlebells on the floor, hinge at your hips with a flat back, and grip both handles firmly.
Hike both kettlebells high between your legs, then extend your hips explosively to drive the bells upward close to your body.
As the bells rise past your chest, guide your elbows back and slide your hands through the handles into an overhead lockout.
Lower the bells to your shoulders, then swing them between your legs and guide them onto the floor.
tips: Punch your hands up swiftly before the bells reach the top so they roll softly onto your forearms rather than flipping hard.
Brace your core tightly at overhead lockout to prevent your lower back from arching.
